name: Palm Beach Resort
description: With a wide range of conveniences and amenities, the one, two, and three-bedroom accommodations at Palm Beach Resort make the perfect home away from home. Spend the day exploring all this beach town has to offer and end your day relaxing in your spacious accommodations. Cook a meal for your family in the fully equipped kitchens or take advantage of the onsite access to watch the sunset from the beach. No matter what time of year your visit, a stay at the Palm Beach Resort is guaranteed to make lifelong memories. To increase sustainability and conserve the earth's natural resources Palm Beach Resort is going green! We are now a contactless front desk. You will receive an email 7 days before you check in to fill out your guest registration. On the day of your arrival, you will receive a text message from our front desk with your check in instructions!
